headline: Tata Sons Board Approval Tied To Chairperson Agreeing To Permanently Carry Portable Power Bank For Life
body: The conglomerate's board has officially granted a fresh five-year term to its executive head, contingent upon him carrying a fully charged 20,000mAh power bank at all times to prevent any corporate device from dropping below 80% battery. Sources confirm the chairperson has already begun wearing a custom-tailored vest with dedicated pockets for three separate charging cables.
caption: Guess who’s never letting a phone die again? Tata Sons sets a new standard for 'connected' leadership. 🔋💼 #TataSons #CorporateLife #PowerMove (satire)
igHook: Tag the colleague who is always at 2% battery.
imagePrompt: A close-up, professional photograph of a person's torso wearing a formal suit jacket with multiple charging cables visibly protruding from the breast pocket, set against a blurred corporate office background.

sourceHeadline.title: Tata Sons board approves fresh 5-year term for Chandrasekaran

judgeVerdict.reasoning: Candidate 10 succeeds by applying a mundane, hyper-specific corporate anxiety (battery levels) to a high-level executive decision, avoiding the clichéd 'printer' or 'musical chairs' tropes found in the other submissions. It balances a clear, absurd image with a deadpan tone that treats the executive's custom battery vest as a perfectly rational corporate requirement.
